title: FP&A Senior Analyst
description:
**Why CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO):** When you join CBRE Business services Organization (BSO), you become part of a global leader in commercial real estate and investment services that help businesses and people thrive. At CBRE\- Business services Organization (BSO), We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Job Title – FP\&A Senior Analyst
  
**About the Role:** The FP\&A Senior Analyst serves as a subject matter expert within the BSO team, responsible for the accurate and timely execution of complex finance and operational processes supporting the UK Advisory business. This role encompasses end to end management of CRM operations, compliance coordination, invoice processing, accruals management, and data governance, acting as a quality assurance checkpoint and escalation point for the FP\&A Analyst team. You will be expected to handle the most complex transactions, mentor junior team members, drive process standardisation, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service quality.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

CRM Operations \& Job Management
  
Conduct AML for new customers and change request for existing customers.
  
Set up Customer in Peoplesoft
  
Finance Operations \& Accruals
  
Generate invoices through Finishline and PeopleSoft and manage the approval workflow, ensuring timely submission and stakeholder notification
  
Process complex billing scenarios including credits, re bills, forex adjustments, and intercompany fee share allocations
  
Manage accruals processes in Finishline, ensuring accurate revenue recognition aligned with opportunity instalment schedules
  
Coordinate intercompany invoice processing and reconciliation, including MyBuy voucher coding
  
Manage annual PeopleSoft project code closure and creation cycles for each financial year
  
Data Integrity \& Exception Reporting
  
Run monthly data integrity reports across CRM, PeopleSoft, and compliance systems, identifying and remediating data quality issues
  
Cleanse and organise historic data to support migration, reporting, and audit requirements
  
Serve as a data quality assurance lead, ensuring accuracy and consistency across all operational systems
  
Identify lost or misclassified opportunities and ensure timely updates in coordination with UK Ops team
  
Mentoring \& Process Improvement
  
Provide day to day guidance and technical support to FP\&A Analysts, acting as the first point of escalation for operational queries and process exceptions
  
Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures, training materials, and knowledge base documentation
  
Identify opportunities for further process automation and system integration to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy
  
Participate in SLA performance reviews and contribute insights for service improvement plans
  
Exception Handling, Process Escalation \& Automation Oversight (Level 1\)
  
The FP\&A Senior Analyst serves as the first level of exception escalation within the BSO tiered operating model. FP\&A Analysts escalate exceptions that fall outside standard operating procedures to the FP\&A Senior Analyst for assessment and resolution. Where exceptions exceed the FP\&A Senior Analyst's delegated authority or require cross functional decision making, they are escalated to the BSO Operations Manager (Level 2\).
  
Process Exception Handling
  
Receive, triage, and resolve Level 1 exceptions escalated by FP\&A Analysts across CRM operations, compliance, invoicing, and data integrity processes
  
Investigate root causes of process exceptions, applying judgement and subject matter expertise to determine the appropriate resolution pathway
  
Document exception resolutions and update standard operating procedures where recurring exceptions indicate a gap in process design or guidance
  
Escalate unresolved or high risk exceptions to the FP\&A Manager (Level 2\) with a clear summary of the issue, investigation findings, and recommended resolution options
  
Maintain the exception log for the team, ensuring all exceptions are recorded, categorised, tracked to resolution, and closed within SLA timelines
  
System Integration \& Automation Exception Management
  
Act as the first line of investigation and resolution for exceptions generated by automated billing and revenue recognition system integrations, including data flow failures between Finishline, PeopleSoft, and the CRM (Salesforce/ClientIQ)
  
Monitor automated process outputs to identify errors, reconciliation mismatches, duplicate entries, or missing data arising from system\-to\-system integrations
  
Investigate and remediate automation exceptions relating to invoice generation, accruals postings, instalment scheduling, intercompany allocations, and revenue recognition entries
  
Coordinate with Technology and Finance Systems teams to report integration defects, validate fixes in test environments, and confirm successful reprocessing of failed transactions
  
Identify patterns and recurring automation exceptions, conducting root cause analysis and proposing preventative measures or business rule adjustments to the FP\&A Manager/Team Leader
  
Support user acceptance testing (UAT) for new or updated system integrations affecting billing and revenue recognition workflows, ensuring exception scenarios are adequately tested before go live
  
Maintain a working knowledge of integration logic, data mapping rules, and automation triggers across key finance systems to enable effective first line diagnosis
  
  

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**Invoice processing accuracy and cycle time (target:** 99%\+ accuracy, 48hr turnaround)
  
CRM data integrity scores from monthly audit reports
  
**Compliance check completion rate within SLA (target:** 100% within agreed timelines)
  
Accruals accuracy and timely submission rates in Finishline
  
**Level 1 exception resolution rate (target:** 90%\+ resolved without escalation to Level 2\)
  
Automation exception identification and remediation turnaround time
  
Exception log completeness and categorisation accuracy
  
Quality gate pass rate for compliance documentation
  
  

**What You'll Need:**  

Essential Requirements
  
Degree educated in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline
  
3\+ years of experience in finance operations, shared services, or GBS environments with a focus on billing, invoicing, and CRM management
  
Proficiency in Salesforce (or equivalent CRM), PeopleSoft, and Microsoft Excel (intermediate to advanced: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data analysis)
  
Solid understanding of Conflict of Interest, AML/KYC compliance processes
  
Strong analytical skills with meticulous attention to detail
  
Proven ability to investigate and resolve process exceptions, including experience working with system generated errors and reconciliation breaks
  
Excellent communication skills (written and oral) with the ability to liaise effectively across functions
  
Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential
  
Highly organised with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
  
Desirable Requirements
  
Experience in commercial real estate or professional services
  
Familiarity with FinishLine billing platform and intercompany reconciliation
  
Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members
  
Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
  
Experience supporting UAT or working with system integration testing for finance platforms
  
Understanding of data mapping, automation triggers, and reconciliation logic across ERP and CRM systems
  
  

**Company Perks and benefits:**  

**Health Care:** Health Insurance to Self, Immediate family \& Parents/In\-laws
  
Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees.
  
**Food \& Snacks:** Free Meals \& snacks are provided in all shifts.

**Child Care:** We partner with Klay day care and CBRE employees get 100% waiver on admission fee. This Day school is in our HYD campus.

**Our Values in Hiring:** At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

title: Manager Finance & Accounts
description:
**Job Purpose**

To independently manage and control the company's complete Finance \& Accounting function, including accounting, banking, taxation, working capital, receivables, payables, cash\-flow management, MIS reporting, statutory compliance and financial controls.

The candidate will be responsible for independent financial decision\-making within approved company policies and limits, ensuring accurate accounting, timely statutory compliance, optimum utilization of funds and strong financial discipline across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Finance \& Accounting Management**

Independently manage day\-to\-day Finance \& Finalisation of Accounts operations.  
Reconciliation’s of salary payables and advances, Loans recovery.  
Independently operate and manage Tally Prime accounting software.  
Independently handle the ESI, EPF, PT provisions and implementations in HR Dept.  
Independently manage GST notices, orders, replies, assessments, and demand proceedings.  
Strong knowledge of E\-Way Bill provisions, rules, regulations, and compliance requirements.

**GST, TDS \& Statutory Compliance**

Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements.

Review GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-2B reconciliation, annual GST returns, GST input tax credit, e\-invoicing, e\-way bills and debit/credit notes.

Review TDS applicability and deductions under applicable sections.

Ensure timely TDS payments and returns.

Reconcile TDS records with books and relevant portals.

Coordinate with CA/Tax Consultant for assessments, notices and statutory matters.

Maintain proper documentation for tax audits and statutory audits.

**Required Skills \& Knowledge**

Strong knowledge of Finalization of Accounting Operations.

Advanced knowledge of Tally Prime Edit log.

Strong knowledge of Banking Operations.

Strong knowledge of GST and TDS.  
Strong Knowledge in salary reconciliations/advance/loans (recovery concept)  
Strong Knowledge in Provision for taxation, advance tax, Tds receivable.  
**Preferred:** Construction/project accounting, industrial/service industry, project\-wise costing, ERP/accounting software, banking limits and working\-capital facilities, Bank Guarantee/LC knowledge, audit handling and experience dealing directly with CA, auditors, banks and tax consultants.

**Educational Qualification:**

Mandatory: B. Com / M. Com / CA Inter or equivalent qualification.

Preferred: CA / CMA / ACCA qualification or equivalent professional exposure with relevant exposure.

**Experience**

Minimum: 6 years relevant experience.

Preferred: 6 – 10\+ years.

The candidate should have previously handled Finance \& Accounts with independent responsibility rather than only performing data\-entry/accounting\-executive functions.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on Finance \& Accounts Manager who can independently take ownership of the Finance Department.

The ideal candidate should be commercially minded, analytical, responsible and capable of making practical financial decisions. The person should not be limited to bookkeeping and should have the ability to understand the complete business cycle from Purchase → Inventory/Project → Sales → Receivables → Banking → Cash Flow → Profitability.

The candidate must be comfortable dealing independently with Management, Banks, Customers, Vendors, Auditors, CA/Tax Consultants and internal departments.

Core Competencies: Accounting \+ Banking \+ Taxation \+ Tally Prime \+ Working Capital \+ MIS \+ Commercial Understanding \+ Team Management \+ Decision Making.
